information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The final call consumes that capsule and all common evidence, begins with retract-only authority, transitions to semantic reconstitution only upon an irreducible contradiction witness, and emits one complete policy.
name: Contradiction-Triggered Authority Phase-Change Dyad
organization: two-call sequential nonbranching lineage with one complete executable origin and one evidence-triggered authority-state terminal

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy capsule.

Consume originate_complete_executable and the jointly visible common evidence, retain retract-only authority unless that evidence establishes a contradiction unresolvable by retraction while preserving completeness, then transition authority to semantic reconstitution for the same artifact and emit one policy.
calls.role: evidence-triggered authority-state controller and terminal emitter
